title: fix: C_FindObjects ignores template — returns all slot objects
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c, C_FindObjectsInit ignores the pTemplate parameter entirely. C_FindObjects filters only by slot_id, not by any template attribute (CKA_CLASS, CKA_KEY_TYPE, CKA_ID, etc.).

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.9 requires template matching: only objects whose attributes match every attribute in the template are returned. Returning all objects violates the spec.

Impact: Any application that discovers objects by class (CKO_PRIVATE_KEY), key type (CKK_EC), or ID will get unexpected objects back, breaking standard PKCS#11 usage patterns and making this library unusable as a drop-in for compliant applications.

Fix: Implement template attribute matching in C_FindObjects. For each candidate object, check every template attribute via get_attribute(obj, type) == template_value. Return only objects that match all attributes.
